name: CJ Craig-James
strengths: Craig-James covers ground from the hash to the sideline and intercepts the deep ball without breaking stride.
Craig-James drives from off coverage, closes the out, and hits the catch point on time.
Craig-James reads the out, dives, and finishes the interception with the ball away from his body.
Craig-James fills the alley downhill and squares the runner instead of grabbing high and hoping.
weaknesses: Craig-James still comes in high on some tackles and the aggressive trigger can get him out of place on play-action.
comparison: Craig-James comps to Jeremy Chinn — 6-3 / 220 long safety who can play single-high, close the alley, and still get his hands on the ball.
projection: Craig-James projects as a Year 1 special-teams safety, then a Year 2 rotation piece, with Year 3 starter upside at single-high if he adds mass and stays in phase.
schemeFit: Craig-James fits a long single-high / two-high safety who can range the deep ball and fill the run.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-09-23 from Parker sophomore reel (embed 19296947 / 68afc5668a2aca5d1686b639). Comp height-matched at 6-3 — not a Florida-alum default.
recruitingStory: CJ Craig-James is a 2028 S · listed 6-3 / 185 · Parker (Birmingham, AL) · expected Ole Miss weekend in the Swamp.
angle: Lead with the range pick and the closing hit on the out; Craig-James looks the 6-3 part.
insiderNotes: Craig-James is a long 6-3 / 185 safety who covers ground from the hash to the sideline and intercepts the deep ball in stride. He closes the out, dives on another pick, and fills the alley square. Some tackles still come in high.
